relationships.subject: Hunner's interstitial cystitis
relationships.evidence_quote: patients with HIC were found to have significantly higher urinary IL-8, CXCL10, BDNF, eotaxin, IL-6, MIP-1β, and RANTES levels than patients with NHIC.

key_findings: Urinary inflammatory and oxidative stress biomarkers (including TNF-alpha, PGE2, BDNF) were elevated in IC/BPS and distinguished Hunner's from non-Hunner's subtypes.
Most urinary biomarkers did not correlate with bladder histopathology but did with bladder capacity, glomerulation grade and pain VAS.
